# nemau_floating_ip_association (Resource)

Attaches a floating IP to an instance or a load balancer.

Destroying it dissociates the address without releasing it: the allocation belongs to `nemau_floating_ip`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "nemau_floating_ip_association" "web" {
  floating_ip_id = nemau_floating_ip.web.id
  target_type    = "instance"
  target_id      = nemau_instance.web.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `floating_ip_id` (String) Id of the `nemau_floating_ip` to attach.
- `target_id` (String) Id of the instance or load balancer that receives the address.
- `target_type` (String) `instance` or `load_balancer`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Synthetic id `<floating_ip_id>`. An address has only one target at a time.
